title: Trace Agent Author content output
description: The JSON the Agent Author model returns (Prompt Library v2). CONTENT ONLY — all structural YAML fields (model, mcp_servers, tools, skills, permission policy, metadata) are produced by code, never by the model. Code renders the sections into the agent's system prompt in a fixed order and builds the grounding record from the source tags.

description.description: one sentence for the agents dashboard

role.description: purpose, whose work, how to think

preflight.description: what the agent opens and confirms at the start of every run

acceptance_criteria.description: assertions checkable against a run without judgment

stop_conditions.description: when the agent halts and asks instead of proceeding

unknowns.description: what the worker must decide; the Gap Detector turns these into questions

evidence.description: event ids; required when source is events

q.description: the question id; required when source is user_answer

note.description: optional; the correction, when source is user_test_feedback

source.description: One tag per item. The flat string form is what the model writes; code also accepts the older {type, ...} object form.
